title: The Jordan chains that one polynomial heads, on the cut-open torus at powers of two
claim: At n = 2^m, h = n/2, q = 2n, for a in GF(q)* with b = sqrt(a), G = G_b the least-degree element of ker X_b (KLOOSTERMAN-BOUNDS-20261110-001A) and k = h - deg G: (1) Z(w) = S + w^(1-n) M_(eps(w^-2 k)) on F[k]_(<h) satisfies det Z(w) = w^(h(1-n)) det(I + C_s(w)) and Z(a) = X_b; with Phi(u) = u^(-h) eps(u^-1 k), Z(a + delta) = S + (a + delta) M_(Phi(a^2 + delta^2)), so the Taylor coefficients of order i >= 1 are multiplications, Z_(2i+1) = a^-1 Z_(2i) for i >= 1 and Z_1 = a^-1 (Z_0 + S); (2) Z(w) is self-adjoint for <F, G> at every w, so the partial multiplicities at a are those of the ceil(k/2) x ceil(k/2) Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction to ker X_b; (3) <Z_1 G Y^i, G Y^j> = a^-1 [Y^(h-1-i-j)] N(G), N(G) = G(k) G(k + 1) of degree h - k in Y, so this first-order matrix vanishes but for one corner when k is odd and the eigenvalue 1/a has exactly k mod 2 Jordan blocks of size 1; (4) for 2i < k - 1, a^-1 k G Y^i solves Z_0 phi = Z_1 G Y^i. Computed exactly (the chain lemma): G Y^j heads a Jordan chain of exactly 2k - 1 - 4j and these are the Jordan blocks, at every a for sides 8 to 64 (64 in the run registered before it was made) and, in the stress run, at nine values of a of side 128 (k = 1 to 15), stress test pending at closure; so the multiplicity of 1/a is k(k + 1)/2 with k read off deg G alone. The target registered with this ticket, a proof of the chain lemma, is not reached beyond its first order.
failure_conditions: A side 2^m and a in GF(2n)* at which det Z(w) differs from w^(h(1-n)) det(I + C_s(w)) or Z(a) differs from X_b.
A side and a at which some G_b Y^j heads a chain of length other than 2k - 1 - 4j (computed false at sides 8 to 32; side 64 is a planned check after registration).
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).
